method: Nineteen performance/diversity/frequency/exit roles on inspected finite history. Exit choices are deadline-only or +20/+50/+100% of entry capital with the same loss stop/deadline. Positive return, <=40% portfolio DD, >=20 fills (18 only at30bp). Two 1:1 endpoints and a full-session >=1:100 endpoint. Prefer deadline-only for financially identical allowed exit choices, then20% for identical loss limits. Prescribed nonbinding profit endpoints stay explicit through target-hit counts. Keep >=75% of role-best log-return/(0.05+DD)+0.5*log-return, then55% relative quality/45% minimum parameter distance including exit. Ten >=18/year roles. Frozen tier budget; no unrelated incumbent displaced. Not independent validation.
